verses.text: We have heard with our ears, O God, Our fathers have told us, What work thou didst in their days, In the days of old.

segments.text: We have heard with our ears, O God,
Our fathers have told us,
What work thou didst in their days,
In the days of old.

verses.text: Thou didst drive out the nations with thy hand; But them thou didst plant: Thou didst afflict the peoples; But them thou didst spread abroad.

segments.text: Thou didst drive out the nations with thy hand;
But them thou didst plant:
Thou didst afflict the peoples;
But them thou didst spread abroad.

verses.text: For they gat not the land in possession by their own sword, Neither did their own arm save them; But thy right hand, and thine arm, and the light of thy countenance, Because thou wast favorable unto them.

segments.text: For they gat not the land in possession by their own sword,
Neither did their own arm save them;
But thy right hand, and thine arm, and the light of thy countenance,
Because thou wast favorable unto them.

verses.text: Thou art my King, O God: Command deliverance for Jacob.

segments.text: Thou art my King, O God:
Command deliverance for Jacob.

verses.text: Through thee will we push down our adversaries: Through thy name will we tread them under that rise up against us.

segments.text: Through thee will we push down our adversaries:
Through thy name will we tread them under that rise up against us.

verses.text: For I will not trust in my bow, Neither shall my sword save me.

segments.text: For I will not trust in my bow,
Neither shall my sword save me.

verses.text: But thou hast saved us from our adversaries, And hast put them to shame that hate us.

segments.text: But thou hast saved us from our adversaries,
And hast put them to shame that hate us.

verses.text: In God have we made our boast all the day long, And we will give thanks unto thy name for ever. [Selah

segments.text: In God have we made our boast all the day long,
And we will give thanks unto thy name for ever. [Selah

verses.text: But now thou hast cast us off, and brought us to dishonor, And goest not forth with our hosts.

segments.text: But now thou hast cast
us
off, and brought us to dishonor,
And goest not forth with our hosts.

verses.text: Thou makest us to turn back from the adversary; And they that hate us take spoil for themselves.

segments.text: Thou makest us to turn back from the adversary;
And they that hate us take spoil for themselves.

verses.text: Thou hast made us like sheep appointed for food, And hast scattered us among the nations.

segments.text: Thou hast made us like sheep
appointed
for food,
And hast scattered us among the nations.

verses.text: Thou sellest thy people for nought, And hast not increased thy wealth by their price.

segments.text: Thou sellest thy people for nought,
And hast not increased
thy wealth
by their price.

verses.text: Thou makest us a reproach to our neighbors, A scoffing and a derision to them that are round about us.

segments.text: Thou makest us a reproach to our neighbors,
A scoffing and a derision to them that are round about us.

verses.text: Thou makest us a byword among the nations, A shaking of the head among the peoples.

segments.text: Thou makest us a byword among the nations,
A shaking of the head among the peoples.

verses.text: All the day long is my dishonor before me, And the shame of my face hath covered me,

segments.text: All the day long is my dishonor before me,
And the shame of my face hath covered me,

verses.text: For the voice of him that reproacheth and blasphemeth, By reason of the enemy and the avenger.

segments.text: For the voice of him that reproacheth and blasphemeth,
By reason of the enemy and the avenger.

verses.text: All this is come upon us; yet have we not forgotten thee, Neither have we dealt falsely in thy covenant.

segments.text: All this is come upon us; yet have we not forgotten thee,
Neither have we dealt falsely in thy covenant.

verses.text: Our heart is not turned back, Neither have our steps declined from thy way,

segments.text: Our heart is not turned back,
Neither have our steps declined from thy way,

verses.text: That thou hast sore broken us in the place of jackals, And covered us with the shadow of death.

segments.text: That thou hast sore broken us in the place of jackals,
And covered us with the shadow of death.

verses.text: If we have forgotten the name of our God, Or spread forth our hands to a strange god;

segments.text: If we have forgotten the name of our God,
Or spread forth our hands to a strange god;

verses.text: Will not God search this out? For he knoweth the secrets of the heart.

segments.text: Will not God search this out?
For he knoweth the secrets of the heart.

verses.text: Yea, for thy sake are we killed all the day long; We are accounted as sheep for the slaughter.

segments.text: Yea, for thy sake are we killed all the day long;
We are accounted as sheep for the slaughter.

verses.text: Awake, why sleepest thou, O Lord? Arise, cast us not off for ever.

segments.text: Awake, why sleepest thou, O Lord?
Arise, cast
us
not off for ever.

verses.text: Wherefore hidest thou thy face, And forgettest our affliction and our oppression?

segments.text: Wherefore hidest thou thy face,
And forgettest our affliction and our oppression?

verses.text: For our soul is bowed down to the dust: Our body cleaveth unto the earth.

segments.text: For our soul is bowed down to the dust:
Our body cleaveth unto the earth.

verses.text: Rise up for our help, And redeem us for thy lovingkindness’ sake.

segments.text: Rise up for our help,

headings.text: For the Chief Musician. A Psalm of the sons of Korah. Maschil.
